instruction: Please help change GIMP's theme from 'Light' to 'Dark'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's theme setting from 'Light' to 'Dark' via Edit > Preferences > Interface > Theme. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (theme "Dark") using the existing check_config_status metric. This is the reverse of the original task with similar difficulty.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts GIMP config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses GIMP config format: strips parentheses, splits by whitespace, matches key and value
Expected value {"key": "theme", "value": ""Dark""} semantically matches GIMP config format (theme "Dark")
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type="rule" - directly accesses rule["key"] and rule["value"] without trying to access rule["rules"] or rule["type"]
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are written to disk before evaluation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the definitive source of truth for GIMP theme setting
Logic will work correctly at runtime - no semantic or logical issues detected
